comment: The development builds' ids, let in by debug builds and by builds with the dev-extension feature, never by a release. The Chromium origin is pinned by the public key in silentsilo/browser's dev manifest, so anyone can build an extension with it. The Firefox id is ours only once our AMO submission has claimed it; until then anyone could get it signed there, so it stays here and goes into allowed-origins.json only after that submission.
